text:
sara: Hi all — RCA for yesterday's degraded routing incident is published: https://redwood.internal/rca/2159991234. Short callouts below (TL;DR).

sara: TL;DR: 1) root cause: cache invalidation bug in the routing layer, 2) immediate mitigation: revert to safe routing variant + hotfix deployed, 3) impact: ~18m elevated latency for ~12% of traffic, 4) customer-facing followups coordinated by CS.

sara: Action items (owners & due dates):
- kevin: finish backfill and validate KV cache consistency across zones — due 2025-06-05
- maria: add a canary that exercises the invalidation path to CI — due 2025-05-30
- tom: update rollout playbook and add fallback smoke test — due 2025-06-02
- sara: coordinate customer comms and postmortem summary for execs — due 2025-05-29

sara: Please ack your items here and drop any blockers. We'll do a 30-day check-in to confirm the regression tests and telemetry changes held. Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood/30day-checkin-215999.

kevin: Ack. I started the backfill earlier — seeing ~60% completed on staging. Not blocking but will need an extra hour of infra quota next Tue to finish.

maria: Ack. I'll prototype the canary today; question — should the canary be in prod as a short-lived job or in staging? leaning prod but small traffic.

sara: @maria prod small-traffic canary is fine — please coordinate with eng-infra for quota.

tom: Ack. Will PR rollout playbook updates this morning. Also adding the smoke test to the release pipeline.

kevin: One note — KV cache schema change in the hotfix needs a migration flag. I'll include a toggle so we can rollback without another deploy.

maria: +1 on toggle. If anyone hits quota issues for canary, ping me and I'll temp scale the runner.

incident-bot: Postmortem published: https://redwood.internal/rca/2159991234 — reactions encouraged.

sara: Thanks everyone. If you can't meet a due date, update the RCA action table and @sara so we can reassign. Expect a short follow-up thread when the 30-day check confirms closure. :thumbsup:

kevin: Noted, will update if anything slips.

maria: Scheduling note — I'll block a quick sync with infra for tomorrow to get quota sorted.

tom: Added a short checklist to the PR for rollout verification.

sara: Closing thread for now — ping me directly for urgent stuff.
